about: Filtered extracts used to build the Packets vocabulary bank (packets_vocab_bank_en.js, packets_vocab/en-<n>.json) by dev-tools/build_packets_vocab_bank.cjs. Made by dev-tools/prepare_packets_vocab_vendor.cjs from the downloads below: only the entries for the words the bank can hold (unit words, NAWL, Word Sounds built-in words and the 10,000 most common Word Sounds words, plus their base forms). Not deployed (.assetsignore).
checking: The bank's corrections (data/packets_vocab_curation_en.json) were checked and corrected with AI assistance on 2026-11-12; not reviewed by a person. A teacher can edit every item before a packet is made.

simple_wiktionary.name: Simple English Wiktionary, kaikki.org wiktextract extract
simple_wiktionary.author: Wiktionary contributors (extracted by Tatu Ylonen's wiktextract, kaikki.org)
simple_wiktionary.license: Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International (CC BY-SA 4.0); Wikimedia text is also available under the GFDL

extract.what: word -> entries {pos, forms, senses: {g (first gloss), tags, cats (only labels the build acts on), ex, syn, ant, form_of}} for content parts of speech and form-of entries

wiktionary.name: English Wiktionary, kaikki.org post-processed English dictionary (enwiktionary dump 2026-10-01, extracted 2026-10-30)

download.file: the kaikki.org English JSONL (534 MB gz), streamed and filtered on 2026-11-12 to en_wikt_filtered.jsonl (68,858,410 bytes, sha256 9d3f2dc34bbe4e280b556efac9914824212ebddb4f5ad947daaacaa71c513d8f); the raw file was deleted

wiktionary.author: Wiktionary contributors (extracted by wiktextract, kaikki.org)
wiktionary.license: Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International (CC BY-SA 4.0); also GFDL

extract.what: word -> entries {pos, forms, senses: up to 6 per entry, slang/old/rare/offensive-labelled senses dropped: {g (most specific gloss), ex (up to 2 usage examples, no quotations)} or {form_of}}

wordnet.name: Open English WordNet 2025 edition (WN-LMF XML)
wordnet.author: the Open English WordNet team; based on Princeton WordNet 3.1 (Princeton University)
wordnet.license: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0), with the Princeton WordNet License for the underlying data
wordnet.licenseFilesFrom: OEWN_LICENSE.md and WNDB_License.txt are LICENSE.md and WNDB_License.txt from the main branch of github.com/globalwordnet/english-wordnet, unchanged (OEWN_LICENSE.md is identical to the LICENSE.md in the release); CC-BY-4.0.txt is https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/legalcode.txt, unchanged

extract.what: lemmas (wanted words only) -> synset ids per pos; synsets of those words with gloss, members, examples (up to 3) and hypernym/similar/antonym/topic/attribute/pertainym links, plus the ancestors they need (names only); hyponyms are rebuilt from hypernyms

nawl.name: New Academic Word List 1.2 (Browne, Culligan & Phillips 2013)
nawl.author: Charles Browne, Brent Culligan and Joseph Phillips

extract.what: the 959 headwords and their part of speech only (the list's definitions and translations are not used)

unit: the hand-made K-8 unit list (86 words, AlloFlow); nawl; builtin and common: from word_sounds_wordlist_en.js; zipf: CYP-LEX children's-book frequency (CC BY 4.0, data/vendor/cyplex) for these words and their forms
